build_summary: Recovery Room artefact built per RecoveryDesignSpecification. All components and states implemented as specified, with evidence-bound values and explicit consent paths. No data stored without explicit 'Share observation' action. Reduced-motion and accessibility requirements met.

experience_definition.name: Signal Garden
experience_definition.customer_promise: Inspect your team's usage signals without pressure, and choose whether to explore workflow clarity.

regions.implemented_behavior: Renders three signal strands (Feature Adoption, Active Users, Session Frequency) and seat utilisation card with exact values from evidence keys. Each strand expands on focus to show tooltip with citation. Seat utilisation displays only cited percentage. Focus order proceeds through canvas to persistent exit and page navigation. No interpretation or aggregation beyond cited evidence.

Appears when 'Clarify workflow friction?' button is activated. Contains optional observation text area and explicit 'Share observation'/'Not now' buttons. Modal traps focus, announces purpose, and respects reduced-motion preferences. Observation only sent to consent-logged endpoint on explicit 'Share observation' click. 'Not now' or escape dismisses modal without side effects.

Displays after signal inspection or modal closure: 'Thank you for exploring your signal garden. Your team's patterns are yours to act on—or not.' Uses role='status' and aria-live='polite'. Fades after 5 seconds unless reduced motion preferred, then appears static. Contains no persuasion, urgency, or next-step suggestion.

required_disclosures: Email outreach is one-time and permitted only by preference profile; no automated sequences or secondary CTAs.
No data from signal inspection is stored, used for profiling, or shared without explicit 'Share observation' action.
Observation sharing is explicit, purpose-limited to improving the signal garden, and not retained beyond that scope.
Decline at any point (email non-engagement, modal dismiss, or non-interaction) implies no further contact or obligation.
The experience does not infer causality between signals, suggest diagnostic conclusions, or assign sentiment to usage patterns.

residual_risks.risk: Customer may perceive signal inspection as judgment despite neutral framing
residual_risks.control: Signal strands labelled as observational data with explicit 'No action required' messaging; tone is curious, not corrective.

residual_risks.risk: Optional clarification could feel like a soft sell
residual_risks.control: Clarification request framed as helping improve the signal garden itself; observation field optional and not required to proceed.
